text:
tara: quick 12min sync  orbit cadence for benchmark launch + newsletter drip. outcome: webinar signups, bench downloads, demo-qualified leads. target send week after next.
oliver: proposed flow: Day0 launch newsletter (bench highlights + CTA register) -> Day3 deep-dive (use case) -> Day6 reminder + social proof -> Day10 post-webinar download + demo CTA. also a light 1-week nurture for non-clickers.
nehru: segmentation idea: Signal segments instead of broad lists: "heavy-API", "infra-ops", "platform-pm", and a cold content cohort. each gets a tailored first sentence + distinct subject line tone (technical vs outcome).
jen: creative notes: hero set = engineer dashboard (variant X) + savings chart (variant Y). also make an explainer GIF (800x450) to show KV cache effect. will export images as PNG + webp.
aj: deliverability checklist: use SendGrid pool "orbit-bench-1". confirm IP warmness and dedicated pool for enterprise seeds. enable throttles: heavy-API 1.2k/min, infra-ops 800/min, platform-pm 600/min, cold 400/min. set recipient_daily_cap=2 for campaign.
deliver-bot: ESP health: pool "orbit-bench-1" warming 83%, predicted steady in 30h. calendar automation: enabled.
nehru: personalization matrix: for heavy-API test 3 variants -> tech-first, ROI-first, social-proof-first. sample split 35/35/30. track with utm_campaign=orbit_bench_q2 & utm_content=tech/roi/social.
tara: subject ideas (short):
- "New LLM benchmark: real per-token economics"
- "How teams cut inference spend without sacrificing latency"
- "Join our benchmark walkthrough + live demo"
preheaders: "Live Q&A + bench findings" / "Bench numbers + actionable tips"
jen: call-to-action flow: primary CTA -> register (calendar + RSVP). post-reg: immediate bench download email + 24h reminder. demo CTA present in all messages as secondary.
aj: infra notes: implement prefix suppression to avoid duplicate sends same day. retry policy: exponential backoff on 5xx, max_retries=6. also preserve link shortener mapping so CRM captures original utm params.
nehru: creative testing: warm cohort -> subject A/B + first-line personal vs generic. cold cohort -> single subject with creative variant A/B. include plain-text variant for enterprise prospect sends.
oliver: timeline: assets due Tue noon (jen), copy by Tue EOD (nehru), audience export Wed AM (data team). approvals need to be wrapped by Thu 3pm PT.
tara: analytics: events: email_sent, email_open, email_click, webinar_registered, bench_download, demo_requested. tag event metadata with "campaign:orbit_bench_q2" and "segment:<name>". forward to analytics and CRM in near real-time.
jen: upload path: /marketing/assets/orbit_bench_q2/. Will place PNGs, webp, and GIF by Tue 11:30am.
aj: QA: internal seed list (tara, oliver, aj, jen, nehru) + 6 external test accounts across Gmail/Outlook/AppleMail. run checklist: images render, alt text present, calendar ics attaches, unsubscribe link functional, and link tracking intact.
deliver-bot: automation check: calendar invite flows map to registrant -> 24h reminder -> 1h reminder. fallbacks: if demo slots full at booking, redirect to sandbox + waitlist.
nehru: regional send consideration: APAC-friendly window for cold lists (09:30 HKT), but keep primary live webinar time US-friendly. test a separate APAC send for registered folks in that timezone.
tara: legal & privacy: include GDPR consent blurb for EU recipients and suppress EU do-not-contact flags. cc legal@redwood.ai for copy approval.
jen: small copy ask: use "per-token cost" in technical lines, but keep conversational tone in general audience.
aj: any blocking infra issues?
oliver: need final audience dedupe script from Data; otherwise clear.
nehru: I'll draft the 3 subject variants + the first-line personalization snippets and push to the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/orbit/subject-lines by Mon.
tara: perfect. reconvene Wed for audience QA. thanks all :sparkles:
